correctness.rationale: Each factor distance partition about any root is equitable with transitions 0→1:k; 1→0,1,2:1,λ,k−λ−1; 2→1,2:μ,k−μ. Multiplying by counts a,b,c yields the five exact profile quotient transitions in RESULT.md. This prevents splitting within profiles and makes all class multiplicities factor-independent. A marked root propagates outward one graph-distance shell per synchronous step; shells at distances 2d−1 and 2d still share the far-region colour through 2d−2, so earlier stability is impossible. In the μ=2, k=2λ+2 regime, lower/same/upper shell degrees depend only on s=b+2c, so the distance shells are equitable and become distinct by round 2d−1. For μ≠2, B_s=s+(μ−2)c distinguishes coordinate profiles at round s; for μ=2 but k≠2λ+2, A_s=λs+(k−2λ−2)c distinguishes at the next round. The standard SRG parameter equation (v−k−1)μ=k(k−λ−1) supplies (1+(k/2)z)^(2d) distance sizes in the exceptional regime, and multinomial choices yield general profile sizes. Independently iterated this quotient refinement for C4, rook, Petersen and Clebsch parameters through d=5, matching sharp rounds and both class regimes. These experiments corroborate the uniform proof.
